title: Defamation of character and extortion; Yelp salesperson has friends leave bad reviews!
summary: Louis Rossmann lays out evidence that a Yelp salesperson had friends leave negative reviews of his repair shop after he declined advertising. He frames it as extortion and defamation.
why: HN commenters cite it as evidence for claims that Yelp pressures businesses over advertising, mostly in threads about Yelp's practices.

quote.text: I suggest you watch this even if you like Yelp. It was definitely eye opening.
